items.title: Iran denies Trump's claim that new talks will begin on Monday
items.description: While Iran denies that talks with the US are taking place, it is currently in negotiations with Oman over Strait of Hormuz access.

items.title: 'My only son was shot standing up for justice' - inside city gripped by deadly protests in Pakistan-administered Kashmir
items.description: The BBC gains unique access to Rawalakot, scene of violent clashes between security forces and protesters in Pakistan-administered Kashmir.

items.title: Aung San Suu Kyi appears healthy in first confirmed outside contact for 2.5 years
items.description: Photos newly released by Myanmar's military government show Suu Kyi meeting with an ICRC official.

items.title: Two workers killed in blast after re-entering quake-hit Japan mall on boss' order
items.description: The two women's employer has apologised for sending them back to Aeon Mall to secure cash.

items.title: US and Japan take action to prop up yen in rare joint move
items.description: Both countries have said that they will not hesitate to conduct joint interventions in the future.

items.title: Ariana Grande to take a break from public life amid 'endless' scrutiny
items.description: The US singer, 33, will "step back from visibility" at the end of her world tour next month, her representative says.

items.title: Massive Attack respond after Singapore ban over Palestine display
items.description: The UK band says they are "surprised and disappointed" by their treatment over shouting "free Palestine" at a concert there.

items.title: Todd Blanche formally withdraws Trump's 'anti-weaponisation' fund plan
items.description: Two Republican senators wanted a written guarantee that Trump would not revive a controversial proposal.

items.title: Sudan army drone strike on court session kills 35, rights group says
items.description: The army has not commented on claims that civilians died in the attack on a paramilitary-held village.

items.title: Malaysian boy on trial for allegedly murdering girl in school
items.description: The high-profile case has shocked Malaysia and sparked debate about the effect of social media on children.

items.title: Two crew killed after firefighting helicopters collide in Greece, as British pilot survives
items.description: One Danish and one Greek national died in the incident, while a British pilot and another Greek crew member survived.

items.title: At least 13 killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza after Hamas agree disarmament deal
items.description: Israel says it was targeting military operatives in the strikes on Gaza City, Khan Younis and Deir el-Balah.
